purpose: Teach: スニーカー/きゅうり/太く/ねじ/子守/鈍感/包む/乗り場

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新しい、本気で、絶対、スニーカー、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、葵に、絶対、似合うわよ
lines.en: Aoi, those new sneakers are absolutely perfect on you.
lines.style: Warm, affectionate opening. Mei's voice brightens as she settles into genuine admiration. Steady pace, no rush. The confidence of someone who knows what suits someone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、夏限定、絶対、きゅうり、絶対、サンドイッチ、絶対、用意してるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. And I've got cucumber sandwiches ready for the summer rush.
lines.style: Light, matter-of-fact. Aoi mentions this like it's just another small thing she's thought through. A gentle smile in the voice—not defensive, just quietly competent.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の柱、本気で、絶対、太く、絶対、立派よね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: The pillars in your shop are so sturdy and well-built. I really admire that about you.
lines.style: Mei's voice shifts to something more observant and sincere. She's noticing the details that show care. Slower, more deliberate. Genuine respect underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お店の、本気で、絶対、ねじ、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、点検、絶対、お願いしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: My dad helped me inspect the fittings last week. Just wanted to make sure everything was solid.
lines.style: Practical, slightly self-deprecating. Aoi doesn't make a big thing of it—just mentions what needed doing and did it. Quiet competence. A small exhale like 'it's done now.'

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お友達の、絶対、子守、絶対、引き受けたのよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: And you've been so good about watching your friend's kids. That takes real dedication.
lines.style: Mei's voice brightens again with animated recognition. She's cataloging all the ways Aoi shows up. Warm, a little delighted to be noticing these things out loud.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、味の変化、絶対、鈍感、絶対、なところ、絶対、あるかも、メイちゃん
lines.en: Though I'll admit, I'm not always great at picking up on flavor changes. That's my blind spot.
lines.style: Self-aware, a little wry. Aoi laughs gently at herself without bitterness. It's the comfort of someone who doesn't need to perform being perfect.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お土産、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、包む、絶対、姿、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、好きよ
lines.en: But the way you wrap gifts—so careful, so thoughtful—I really love that about you.
lines.style: Mei's voice softens into tenderness. She's moved by the small gesture. Unhurried, each word landing with quiet significance. This is genuine affection, no performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お店の前、本気で、絶対、タクシー乗り場、絶対、近いの、葵で、便利よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: And having the taxi stand right outside the shop is really convenient, you know?
lines.style: Aoi's voice is warm and close, like she's sharing a small satisfaction. Not boastful—just comfortable with the space she's made for herself. Gentle, grounded.
